java_data_flow: Display#getCreole reads ISkinSimple#getPadding and constructs SheetBlock1 with that padding and explicit horizontal margins.

SheetBlock1 stores ClockwiseTopRightBottomLeft.same(padding), translates drawing by left/top padding, and calculateDimensionSlow calls XDimension2D.delta(padding.getBottom() + padding.getTop()); XDimension2D.delta(one_arg) adds the same value to width and height.
EntityImageDescription builds the description body with BodyFactory#create3, which returns BodyEnhanced2; BodyEnhanced2#getMarginX returns 0.
USymbolUsecase#asSmall merges stereotype and label top-to-bottom, then feeds that block into TextBlockInEllipse for both measurement and drawing.
rust_data_flow: SkinColors::from_meta resolves global skinparam Padding into creole_padding.
use_case_dim uses creole_padding in body block dimensions, stereotype block dimensions, footprint atoms, and TextBlockInEllipse-style radii.

inputs.summary: Rejected counterexample: Java canvas is 619x107 while Rust is 597x107; the first use-case ellipse differs (expected rx=156.6145 ry=43.6142, actual rx=156.444 ry=43.5691), stereotype textLength differs (75.0703 vs 72.1758), and the downstream node, route, arrowhead, and link label shift.

Rejected counterexample: with explicit Padding 0, Arial text baselines and one relation stereotype textLength diverge. This is not a padding-value proof failure by itself, but it violates the claimed acceptance that padding-zero/font-axis held-outs retain exact output.

findings.title: Fresh valid held-outs are not all byte/structure exact
findings.detail: Two of four use-case perturbations fail diff_one --no-oracle. The Verdana/stereotype/padding/topology case directly exercises the mechanism's advertised axes and changes ellipse geometry plus downstream layout. The Arial/Padding 0 fanout shows a control-axis residue. Under the T14 held-out rule, these counterexamples reject the mechanism even though the high-level Java padding account is plausible.

findings.title: No fixture-shaped product logic found
findings.detail: The touched Rust renderer surface did not contain branches keyed to the four original themed fixtures, theme names, golden paths, or fixture labels.

residue: The rejecting use-case failures may partly belong to font/stereotype metrics or link-label layout rather than the scalar padding data flow alone. They still block acceptance because the mechanism account explicitly included font, stereotype, topology, and padding-zero axes as held-out validation requirements.
